title: National Do Not Call Registry - basics
facts: Consumers can register eligible personal phone numbers on the National Do Not Call Registry for free.

Registration does not block every call; categories such as certain political calls, charitable solicitations, debt-collection calls and informational calls can be treated differently under applicable law.
Scammers may ignore the registry, so registration does not itself verify that an incoming call is legitimate.
Consumers can report unwanted sales calls and robocalls through federal complaint channels.
